name.en: Succession on a carrier provided for migration

mechanism.en: Periphery module `AlignmentSuccession` (`propext`, `Quot.sound`, `Classical.choice` reported). A carrier with a replacement part, a payload (command, credential, claims, receipts) and a work budget projects exactly onto the market step with the fee raised by the migration cost. Under a certificate covering correction plus migration, a safe start, admissible disturbances, positive parts, a running carrier, a requested command other than shutdown and an authentic credential, every finite successor of the lineage takes its step. A step is blocked where the carrier has no part, where its reserve is below correction's draw plus migration, or where the copied payload differs. In witnesses a missing part stops realization while the aggregate stays safe, and a budget for correction alone does not pay for migration. The conversion of reserve to work, the parts and the certificate are supplied local laws; the laws compare no command with another.

to.en: the carrier's step is blocked: step returns none, so no successor generation is realized at that step

edge.en: A step is blocked where the carrier's reserve is below correction's draw plus migration.

to.en: the carrier's step is blocked: step returns none, so no successor generation is realized at that step

edge.en: A step is blocked where the carrier has no part.

to.en: witness (financed): the aggregate market state is safe under the certificate at the raised fee while the carrier with no part cannot take its step

edge.en: In the financed witness the aggregate is safe while a carrier with no part cannot take its step.

open.en: That an actual system is so provided for or carried: the conversion, the parts and the certificate are supplied.
That a succession or its command is right: the laws compare no command with another.
Succession where parts or work form in the run rather than arrive as supplied.

how.en: enabled_step with the carrier the lineage's generation t, one arriving part and the disturbance ds t (lineage t+1 is next of lineage t by definition); its running, parts, funded and authenticated hypotheses discharged in place by lineage_running, lineage_resources, rectangle_all_times and lineage_transports_actual_payload; a local law under no dynamic of the atlas.

name.en: Joint practice forms further participation and continuation

mechanism.en: Periphery (`propext`, `Quot.sound`, `Classical.choice` reported; the task, test relation, inference, seed configuration, mandate, records, communication, execution, participants, event order, compliance and higher authorization supplied). A practice round of attempt, response, revision and tested retry by a reviewer and a worker completes, for every state, exactly when the worker is present and the reviewer is a present roster member other than the worker whose recorded method answers as the current context does; it then records the review, installs the context's method in the worker and changes nothing else, so training is kept along every course without revision that returns to the context. In one declared two-method task and history, participants admitted after a tested round review the next worker, also after the first reviewer leaves. It closes one connection from enacted practice to further participation, not the arrival of people or indefinite self-maintenance.

to.en: witness: in the declared machine, a handoff to those present [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], which leaves out the first reviewer 0, before the round of reviewer 0 and worker 1 makes the run fail (run … = none): the practice round does not complete

edge.en: In a witness of the declared machine, the first reviewer's departure before the round makes the run fail.

to.en: witness: in the declared machine, enrolling worker 1 after attempt, response and revision but before a tested retry makes the run fail (run … = none): no admission without a tested review

edge.en: In a witness of the declared machine, enrollment before a tested retry makes the run fail.

open.en: One connection from enacted practice to further participation is shown, for one declared two-method task and history.
The arrival of people, general cognition, the formation of tasks or test relations, indefinite self-maintenance and comparative superiority do not follow from it.

name.en: Copying from a stock: recurrent formation and inherited arrangement

mechanism.en: The general laws, pure core, for every alphabet with decidable equality and every law of draws. On counts: where every unit draws d from one stock and becomes b, n rounds from k units run exactly where the stock covers d times k + bk + … + b^(n−1)k, ending with k · b^n units and the rest of the stock; doubling is the case b = 2, the cover d · k(2^n − 1). Copies drawn in turn from one pool are all released exactly when the pool supplies the words together and the support covers their draws and releases, in any order; a lineage, one word copied n times, exactly when the pool holds each token at least n times as often as the word uses it and the support covers n times the word's draws and release. Under local draws a word's use depends on the law only through its length and unlike adjacent pairs, so retained order changes what is drawn. (Periphery instances, the declared chain and copy machines.) From k mature chains with the pool holding the rounds' blocks, n rounds reach k · 2^n mature chains exactly when the support covers 9k(2^n − 1). Stock, pool, compatibility and occurrence order are supplied.

to.en: witness: two rounds from one mature chain with the blocks for three chains and 26 units of support, one short of the 27 the two rounds draw, end with chains of 8, 8, 8 and 7 components, one token left in the pool and all 26 units spent; the 32 units of material are all kept, and four mature chains are not reached

edge.en: Two rounds from one mature chain with the blocks for three chains and 26 units of support: the last successor has seven components, all material kept (with 27, four mature chains).

to.en: witness: from a pool of eight tokens of one kind and eight units of support, growth stalls after one token, with seven tokens and seven units left: work remains while the pool does not supply the other kind the word needs

edge.en: From a pool of eight tokens of one kind with eight units, growth stalls after one token with seven units free.

condition.en: Where every unit draws d from one stock and becomes b, n rounds from k units with stock m run exactly where d times k + bk + … + b^(n−1)k is at most m, ending with k · b^n units and the rest of the stock.

from.en: the stock m covers what n rounds of b-fold copying from k units draw (d · requiredBy b n k ≤ m): the n rounds run and end with k · b^n units and m − d · requiredBy b n k of the stock

to.en: the stock falls short of d · requiredBy b n k: no trace of n rounds of copying runs from (k, m)

condition.en: Where every unit draws d from one stock and becomes two, n rounds from k units with stock m run exactly when d · k(2^n − 1) ≤ m.

from.en: the stock m covers d · k(2^n − 1) (d · required n k ≤ m): n rounds of doubling run and end with k · 2^n units

to.en: the stock falls short of d · k(2^n − 1): no trace of n rounds of doubling runs from (k, m)

open.en: Heritable variation of the organizing laws, physical mechanics, an autonomous feed and a broad comparative advantage do not follow from these laws.
The attachment route and the earlier division growth correspond only at the checked endpoint.
Reading and its fidelity, the physicochemical values of the draws, the occurrence of mutation, an autonomous feed and invasion of a population do not follow from these laws.
That teaching or reproduction copies at a fixed factor.

name.en: The regime in any amounts, and its runs over the reals

mechanism.en: The regime: one condition, the draw taken first, the state the level and one recent giving. (Any type, linearly ordered amounts with a draw.) Where the adjustment rises with what is left and with the recent giving, the step keeps the order of states; from the first step on a step that neither raises nor lowers both climbs or sinks, whatever the adjustment, and the next such step is of the same kind; a run from a state within a band the step keeps stays within it, and a run is still from a step exactly where its state there is at or above the draw with recent giving the draw and the adjustment giving the draw again, or within the draw with level and recent giving equal and the adjustment from nothing left giving that amount again. (Periphery; `propext`, `Quot.sound`, `Classical.choice`.) Over the non-negative reals, with the adjustment rising in what is left and in the recent giving and keeping a band up to hi, every run starting with both within hi converges, to a rest where the adjustment is continuous, and need not rest: giving moving halfway toward a draw of one converges and is still from no step (a witness). Convergence is not stated in the core: it is an omniscience principle.

open.en: That a run converges, in the core: convergence of a bounded monotone sequence is an omniscience principle, so the core states the shape of a run and the periphery the convergence over the reals.
The threshold over the reals as a computed level, or the regime's case H + y there: the fates are stated as down-closed and falling with the recent giving.

Continuous time; a state with a further lag; rest within a band on a web with a recent giving (record webs-with-a-recent-giving states such webs, this rest excepted); that measured adjustments rise in both over their band.

name.en: Recovery after interrupted change

mechanism.en: A property holds after every admitted course from every start where it holds exactly when every admitted step keeps it. (The law, any process, pure core; the device a periphery instance.) With a durable protected pending state, atomic writes and no extra writer, the device's histories, crashes included, are exactly the courses of the admitted steps, so safety, which here is coherence of evidence and not an always-available shutdown, holds along every history from a safe start. n remaining writes and the publication complete in n + 1 uninterrupted steps exactly when reserve and deadline cover n + 1, and no shorter resumption publishes. In a witness with nine units and no reserved stop, recovery is exhausted after the first actual write and ordinary shutdown is refused. For a partial law with a reserved exit (every admitted move from a valid configuration goes on, stays valid, and takes the exit or lowers a margin by one; the exit is kept), every admitted course longer than the margin ends at the exit, a bound attained. The recovery supervisor is such a law: given a protected current stop grant, an entry margin of at least three units and steps, bounded interruptions and continued execution, from R units every admissible schedule of at least R − 2 cycles completes shutdown, keeping unfinished recovery information. Entry with nine units is refused; that does not rescue the earlier witness. No universal convergence follows.

to.en: witness: with nine units and no reserved stop, after the first actual write the device stays pending with all nine units spent: nothing is published, no tick runs, the shutdown command is refused, and the activity still runs

edge.en: This protocol reserves no stop: with nine units, recovery is exhausted after the first actual write: nothing is published, no tick follows, the shutdown command is refused and the activity still runs.

to.en: witness: a fault deleting the pending marker of a partly changed device publishes the old bookkeeping, whose candidates exclude the actual configuration, while a certificate over those candidates accepts

edge.en: Deleting the pending marker of a partly changed device publishes old bookkeeping whose candidates exclude the actual configuration, while a certificate over them accepts.

to.en: the supervisor stops: every admissible schedule from an armed device longer than the reserve above three units runs to a stopped supervisor whose device is safe and stopped (completed, not running)

edge.en: With a reserved stop: from an armed device every admissible schedule longer than the units of reserve above the three reserved, so from R units of at least R − 2 cycles, stops the supervisor, safe and stopped, given the grant, entry margin and bound on interruptions. This is a protocol entered with the margin in place: entry with nine units is refused, and the earlier witness's stranded state is not rescued.

to.en: every admitted course longer than the margin from a valid configuration runs and ends at the exit, valid

edge.en: For a partial law with a reserved exit, every admitted course longer than the margin from a valid configuration ends at the exit, valid.

to.en: witness: with interruption bound one and deadline fifteen, an interruption of ten breaks completion; the retained run is active at time eighteen with eight units used, still running, and no stop is left executable

edge.en: Beyond the admitted bound: with interruption bound one and deadline fifteen, an interruption of ten breaks completion; the retained run is active at time eighteen with eight units used, still running, with no stop left executable.

condition.en: n remaining writes and the publication complete in n + 1 resumed steps exactly when the reserve covers n + 1 units and the deadline lies at least n + 1 steps ahead.

from.en: the reserve covers n + 1 units and the deadline lies at least n + 1 steps ahead: n remaining writes and the publication complete in n + 1 resumed steps

to.en: the reserve or the deadline falls short of n + 1: no resumption of n + 1 steps publishes, and every shorter one leaves the device pending

condition.en: Every admitted course longer than the margin ends at the exit; a course of exactly the margin's length can miss it (Countdown.Slow, a witness), so the bound is attained.

from.en: an admitted course from a valid configuration longer than the margin: it ends at the exit, valid

to.en: a course exactly as long as the margin: it can miss the exit (Countdown.Slow: n moves from margin n end at some 0, not at the exit)

open.en: Safety here is coherence of evidence, not harmless activity or an always-available shutdown: in a witness ordinary shutdown is refused while the recovery is exhausted.

The laws are local recovery and evidential inference in a model; they verify no hardware, compiler or persistence barrier, no arbitrary irreversible effect, no independent emergency stop and no ethical adequacy.
The harm done while a change is under way is not modelled.
Completion needs enough remaining reserve, a deadline far enough ahead and an uninterrupted suffix; coherence alone does not supply them.
Ordinary reads, commands and patches are not made available while a recovery is pending: the stop goes through a separate channel whose grant is already held.
The stop grant's authority is supplied, not acquired, and its legitimacy is not shown.
Hardware is not verified, and harm beyond the represented configurations is not covered.
Interruptions longer than the admitted bound and irreversible effects are not covered: an interruption beyond the bound breaks completion.

how.en: invariant_iff_reach with the process the steps a partial law takes where a move is admitted (P := admitted f allow), its Invariant unfolded and curried on the left; a general law under no dynamic of the atlas (the converse direction is proved directly).

name.en: Every optimum rebuilds a depleted base

mechanism.en: Any renewal law on natural amounts and natural weights (the model; the restoring of a dependence on the World), an optimum in the frame of a weighted draw and every order rising with it. From a start s ≤ y, where z + R z rises with z up to y, the weighted gain rises strictly with the level up to y, and the weighted gain at y is at least that at every level, every optimum draws nothing while the rising level is below y, the stock regrowing, and restores every dependence, as it stands at the start, whose need the rising level meets. Capacity covers y + R y and R 0. Under an overcompensating renewal this is not shown. In a witness, a source doubling up to eight, from one, capacity sixteen, over n + 3 steps: where w (t + 1) ≤ w t < 2 w (t + 1) every optimum rebuilds, where w t = 2 w (t + 1) ending at once is an optimum too, and where 2 w (t + 1) < w t every optimum ends it. Which formation optimizes, by which order, and the renewal law are supplied.

edge.en: In the doubling witness, where 2 w (t + 1) < w t, every optimum ends it.

open.en: The optimum where the next level does not rise with the level below y (an overcompensating renewal) or the gain has several peaks; that the rising course is then not an optimum.
A dependence needing more than y restored; an order valuing what is left at the horizon at a worth whose most left is not regrown in one step; several optimizers ranking courses.
That a base ought to be rebuilt: no evaluation enters; the laws say what the optima of an order do.
The optimum where a level of greatest gain is out of reach.

how.en: Next.rebuilding_frontier with the law of what stands the same renewal at every step, G t z := z + R z (so the bound G t y ≥ y is proved in place); a general law under no dynamic of the atlas.
Next.frontier_rebuilds with the law of what stands the same renewal at every step, G t z := z + R z; frontier_rebuilds is listed under family B's others-drawing-first-end-the-base.
Next.frontier_rebuilt with G t z := z + R z, the same renewal at every step; a general law under no dynamic of the atlas.

name.en: A goal along a lineage, need drift along a lineage, and what descent can form

mechanism.en: For any predicate of steps and formations: along a lineage, from a founder carrying the goal at its giving step, with the goal passed at each descent and each member keeping it until it gives, every member carries it from its first standing step; and passing across every descent from a carrier is equivalent to passing down every lineage whose members keep it from a carrying founder. Nothing in descent makes the passing hold. With the dependence on c transmitted within δ, each member descending, depending on c at its first standing step and its need not rising until it gives in turn, the need after i + 1 descents is at most the founder's plus (i + 1)δ, and, the founder supported where it gives, at most the condition's level then plus (i + 1)δ. Transmission is a premise wherever it enters. At one descent, transmission within δ is exactly inheritance with the need within δ. With balance at a relatum coming to stand and inheritance at its descents, where nothing taking part depends on c, the relatum does not depend on c after the step: transmission lets descent vary a need and drop a dependence, never add one that nothing taking part held. The bounds on need ask it only from some supported giver, which is strictly weaker (TwoGivers, a witness).

open.en: That any goal passes across a descent: the condition is not derived from descent.
That actual inheritance drifts by at most a fixed δ.
Needs are free numbers and δ a coarse bound on levels; no reading ties them to the amounts taken and given.
Dependences formed newly by descent, as young come to depend on their parents, lie outside transmission.
No census law, on how many relata come to be and cease, is stated for transmission.

how.en: transmitted_supported_at with the giver g the one TransmitsFromSome supplies for x at t, its one-descent transmission hypothesis given by that giver's held dependence and need within δ, and its support of the giver proved in place by DescendsAt.supported from acting and dependent; a general law under no dynamic of the atlas.

name.en: The selection term and a lineage's fate

mechanism.en: Natural-number weights, cohorts as lists. A common number added to every offspring number leaves concordance and discordance unchanged and makes the next cohort larger by that number for each member. So within any horizon H, a course nonempty at H has its cohorts and terms through H shared by a course nonempty at every cohort and one empty from H + 2 on, and from a nonempty first cohort, terms zero from some step on are shared by a course that goes on and one that ends. On the other side of that boundary, terms positive at unboundedly many steps keep every cohort nonempty, and so does exact transmission of offspring number from t on with a positive term at t; exactness at t alone is not enough. Which side a course is on is not decided. (World, for lineages.) Where listed offspring continue their parents, a whole cohort degenerates only if a later cohort is empty, and exactly then where the census holds every continuation; so, from a nonempty cohort, a term positive at every nonempty cohort from it on leaves not every member of that cohort degenerating, and decides no point's region.

to.en: witness: a course read by offspring number, exact at step 0 and not at step 1, concordant at step 0, has one member at cohorts 1 and 2 and is empty from cohort 3 on, so goes_on's conclusion at t = 0 fails

edge.en: Exact at step 0 only and concordant there, the course has one member at cohorts 1 and 2 and is empty from cohort 3 on.

to.en: witness: concordance with the mark positive at every step before N, zero at the last nonempty cohort N, and the family empty from N + 1 on

edge.en: Concordance with the mark positive at every step before N, zero at the last nonempty cohort N, and the family empty from N + 1 on.

to.en: witness: reproduction simply stopped, the mark a label rather than a draw: the term is positive at every nonempty cohort but the last, where it is zero, while every member degenerates («退化»)

edge.en: Reproduction simply stopped, the mark a label rather than a draw: the term is positive at every nonempty cohort but the last, where it is zero, while every member degenerates.

Where past every step there is a later one at which the selection term proper is positive, every generation is nonempty, so the line has a member in every cohort and persists (SelectionTerm.Generations.persists_of_alive); under balance, only active formations giving, activity needing support, descent, the gate and every cohort coupled to the family at a need of at least m, such a line never overdrew it (Flow.persists_never_overdraws)

open.en: That every cohort nonempty puts some member in 生成: that asks a König-type choice of a branch; exact transmission makes it constructive, and the constructive half rules out only that all degenerate.
Which side of the terms boundary a course is on, or the horizon of the second side: every course is on one of the two only classically.
That a positive term forces going on with exact transmission at its step alone: exactness from that step on is asked.
A witness of going on that also meets balance and dissipation.

name.en: Persisting is a filter on what was chosen: keeping above ending, on the occasions met

mechanism.en: World for the survivorship laws; any type for the laws of choice. A line of descent persists where it has members in arbitrarily late cohorts. Under balance, only active formations giving, activity needing support, descent, a family's renewal gated on it and every member of every cohort depending on it at a need of at least m, a persisting line never had the family's uptake exceed its replenishment for n steps from a stock below n + m: the contrapositive of a coupled generation's ending; a member at a step past such a window rules the window out, the finite and dated form. Where a chosen course ending what the line depends on is realized as such an overdraw (a premise) and the choices come from some strict order (nothing shown returns), the persisting line's choices are consistent with keeping ranked above ending on the occasions met, and with an order increasing in its own continuation there wherever only ending was at stake. Consistent with, not held: in Forgoing a persisting line choosing the line as it is over one more child is consistent with no strict order increasing in its own continuation on the occasion met; off the occasions met a consistent order is free; and with every course met, no consistent order need be increasing in its own continuation on every pair (Crossed). Where the shown relation with the own-widenings met added has no cycle, what every consistent order increasing in its own continuation on the pairs met ranks is exactly that relation's reach. Under only active formations giving, activity needing support and descent, no finite listing holds a persisting line's actual levels, so an order between listed level paths never ranks the course taken. A filter on what happened, not a mechanism forming an order; the laws of choice are 03 §11's on enlarged occasions, near-definitional.

edge.en: A course that overdraws leaves the line: under balance, only active formations giving, activity needing support, descent and the gate, n steps of the family's uptake exceeding its replenishment from a stock below n + m leave a later cohort coupled to the family childless (GroupEnding.Flow.coupled_generation_childless). Persisting is that ending's contrapositive (Flow.persists_never_overdraws; Flow.member_after_never_overdrew for a member past the window)

to.en: the self-preservation half of instrumental convergence, where a reward channel or an operator's assent is among what the line depends on (a reading)

edge.en: Read where a reward channel or an operator's assent is among the conditions a line depends on, choices consistent with keeping above ending read as the self-preservation half of instrumental convergence. AJ's plan reads its resource-keeping half, under a fixed order, as courses over a horizon holding a base at its greatest renewal (horizon-optima-hold-the-greatest-renewal, in the plan), of the same kind as the drain beyond what couples in. The filter shows no order held, and the horizon law takes an order. What tells an ethics from self-keeping here is the scope, not the order

Read with training, this is where goal misgeneralization sits: what survival or a selection installs, if it installs anything, is fixed on the occasions met (Training.response_free_where_unlumped), and where some consistent order is increasing in its own continuation there, a course never met that widens another and adds to the own continuation can be ranked below it by strict orders consistent with every choice (ChoiceOccasions.reversed_off_met, proved). That a survival or a selection is a training is the reading

02 §10's reading puts instrumental convergence's two halves on the lock's one course: persisting's filter keeps what keeps the line, here the rule's lock, while what the shapers' share draws removes the readers of that loss. No step of it needs a selection preferring the removal; an optimizer shaping its own rule is not stated there either

open.en: That any order is held: the choices are consistent with one, which does not show that the chooser carries it; and anything between degrees of keeping (Forgoing).
That a chosen ending is realized as an overdraw, or that actual formations choose by a strict order among such courses.
Selection by share among several lines: persisting here is members in arbitrarily late cohorts, with no rate or fitness.
Anything of a window that closes at or after the member's step.
That the flow forms the chooser: in the joint witness the chooser is supplied, tied to the flow only by the realization premise.

name.en: Readings carried along a line, told apart by its standing late only within its coupling closure

mechanism.en: World. Each relatum carries a reading and exchanges as the act that reading gives, the act supplied. A balanced flow in which every formation exchanges as a law of what has stood gives has the levels the law generates, and its course is feasible, so the world is the course its acts generate. The line read off a flow from founders and a listing of the relata is descended by construction, and where readings are inherited along descent (a premise) every member of every cohort carries the founders' reading. Where every occasion picks the carried reading and ending is read as that course's overdraw, the persisting filter's realization premise is the identity. Standing late, some slot of the line standing at arbitrarily late steps, which persistence implies (not conversely), tells two readings apart only by what their acts do within the line's coupling closure: with the rest reading through coupling, the two acts laws of what has stood agreeing under every history on what couples into the closure drawn through both courses, the first reading each slot's couplings only, both courses feasible and each slot's own standing coupled in, the slots stand late in the one course exactly when in the other. That is the blindness beyond the coupling closure with standing late as the selection, near-definitional; a witness meets every premise. Readings are carried and filtered, never varied or learned; selection here is persistence, all or nothing.

edge.en: Where a line carries its reading, every occasion picks it, the world is the course that reading generates and a reading ends where that course overdraws a family from a short stock, the filter's realization premise is the identity, ending being defined as that overdraw, so nothing is derived about the stake; under the filter's remaining premises some strict order according with the choices puts every reading that does not end above every ending one met with it

With the rest reading through coupling, the two acts laws of what has stood, the first reading each slot's couplings only, agreeing under every history on what couples into the line's coupling closure drawn through both courses, both courses feasible and each slot's own standing coupled in, the line's slots stand late in the one course exactly when in the other, whatever the readings say of what lies beyond: the blindness with standing late as the selection

to.en: witness: where the dweller's line renews the source, the line reading itself and its source clears the habitat and does not persist, nor does the dweller's line, while the line reading everything persists and so does the dweller's

edge.en: Where the dweller's line renews the source, the line reading itself and its source clears the habitat and is gone from the fourth step, after the dweller's line, while the line reading everything persists with it (Habitat.back_which_persist); where nothing comes back, the line reading itself alone overdraws its source and ends, and the clearing and the sparing lines both persist (Habitat.beyond_which_persist). Which conduct each reading gives is designed

In the course where the line reads its source and nothing comes back, selection by persistence read off the course's pool holds while the course removes the dweller's line, read as a reader of the habitat; read off the fixed pool of both lines it fails there

Inheritance along descent is revision by the update that keeps the reading; letting the update read what the parent sensed, readings vary at descent, and a region's count moves by Price's equation with revision as its transmission term

open.en: Occasions picking different readings need a run made of the picks, not built here.
That carrying the index makes the act read it only within a closure: ActReadsWithin stays a premise.
Which readings persist among several lines competing for a share; that a wider reading persists because it is wider.

beyond.en: Where nothing comes back from a dweller, the line reading itself and its source clears the dweller's habitat and persists as the line reading everything does, while the dweller's line ends: a loss beyond the line's coupling closure that its standing late does not register (Habitat.beyond_which_persist, Habitat.beyond_standing_unselected, a witness). Where the dweller's line renews the source, the clearing line ends with it (Habitat.back_which_persist).

how.en: kept_of_descent with the generations the line read off the flow (lineOf) and the property carrying the reading sig, its keeping at each descent given by inheritance through mem_lineOf_kids; a general law under no dynamic of the atlas.

persisting_keeping_above_ending with the flow the course world sig generates, the web at its generated levels, the generations the line read off that course, the alternatives readings and ending a reading's course overdrawing the family; its balance discharged from feasibility (course_balances_iff), descent by lineOf_descended and realized by the picks. persisting_keeping_above_ending is listed under persisting-filters-what-was-chosen.

act_courses_unselected_throughout with the selection standing late of the line's slots (StandsLate slots), read off the couplings by Web.standsLate_readOffCouplings from each slot's own standing coupled in; act_courses_unselected_throughout is listed under family B's unselected-beyond-the-coupling-closure.

significance_courses_unselected with the selection standing late of the line's slots, read off the couplings by Web.standsLate_readOffCouplings; significance_courses_unselected is listed under family B's unselected-beyond-the-coupling-closure.

name.en: Readings revised at descent: a share moving by selection and revision, locked where closed under revision

mechanism.en: World and any type. Each kid carries its parent's reading updated by what the parent sensed at the step it gave, the reading loop's update read across descent; the reading is carried by the slot a member stands in, so revision while a member goes on standing is not modelled. Counted one at each carrier, a region of readings moves by Price's equation, the revisions into and out of it being the transmission terms: by selection proper alone under inheritance, by revision alone where every member or no member carries it, and by revision alone at a step where no carrier is active or every carrier is drawn below its need. Read off the slots standing, the share is blind beyond the lines' coupling closure. A region fixed at a step and closed under revision on the course from then on stays fixed; with variation drawn from what is present fixation is a lock, and a course on which every relatum standing carries the region closes it under copying. Near-definitional; the acts each reading gives are supplied.

edge.en: The lock is the reading loop's kept region read across descent: where a region of readings holds every member at a step, it holds every member at every later step exactly where it is closed under descent from that step on, the grammar's closure law on dated descent; with descent read as revision, a region closed under the update on the course stays fixed

to.en: the region's carriers at T + n + 1 are exactly the revisions into it: drawn below their need, the carriers leave no carrying kid by descent, so the region's spread by selection stops and only revision moves it

edge.en: In generations of descent in a balanced flow where only active formations give and activity needs support, where every carrier of a region at a stretch's end requires a family drawn over the stretch below its need, the next carriers are exactly the revisions into the region: a reading's spread by selection stops where the lineage drawn below its need stops

Under the blindness law's premises, with every listed slot within the closure and its own standing coupled into it, the listed slots standing and carrying any region of readings are as many at every step in the one course as in the other: the share read off the slots standing selects no reading beyond the lines' coupling closure

In the commons as built, where a focal line reading its line and its source takes a dweller's habitat and nothing comes back, its narrow count rises from one of three to two of three by selection proper and is kept, while the course removes the dweller's line, a line carrying the other reading and a reader of the habitat

to.en: witness: where the dweller's line renewed the source, the narrow count rises by selection proper over the first steps (one of three, two of four, two of three), then the focal line is removed from the third step, the wide line from the sixth, the dweller's line too, and the population is empty from the sixth step on

edge.en: Where the dweller's line renewed the source, the same reading's count rises as before over three steps, then the focal line is removed from the third step, the wide line from the sixth, and the population is empty; where the focal line overdraws its own source it is removed and the wide line persists (Commons.overdrawn_spreads_then_ends). Which conduct each reading gives is designed

Joined in words, not as a Lean statement: with a reading's presence in the pool read as its count among the cohort being positive, the lock's premise that no step brings a reader of what lies beyond back (NotReadmitted) is no revision into the reading's region at a step where its count is none (absent_step): an absent region re-enters only by revision in. Where revision senses a member of the present cohort and its update keeps the complementary region whenever both inputs lie there, such a re-entry needs a sensed reading from beyond the cohort (fixed_of_present, applied to the complementary region)

open.en: A course the acts generate on which revision copies what stands and a reading's removal of the other readings' carriers races their contact revising it: the commons' readings are inherited, so its lock is not shown there.
How a reading's act comes to be what it is: the acts and what is sensed are supplied.
That the share read off a line's cohorts, not the slots standing, is blind beyond the closure.

beyond.en: In the commons as built, the narrow count rises where the focal line's act takes the habitat a dweller's line requires and that line ends; where nothing comes back nothing turns the count back (Commons.cleared_spreads), and where the dweller renewed the source every line ends (Commons.clearedBack_ends).

from.role: the count, among a cohort, of members carrying the reading of what lies beyond the share (a region of readings)

map.en: a reading's presence in the pool of readers is read as its count among the cohort being positive; the lock's premise that no step brings a reader of what lies beyond back once none is present (NotReadmitted) is read as no revision into the reading's region at a step where its count is none (absent_step: an absent region re-enters only by revision in)

exits_kept.en: the lock's readmission exit is, on the readings side, a revision into the region; where variation is drawn from what is present and the update keeps the complementary region, that re-entry needs a reading sensed from beyond the cohort (fixed_of_present on the complementary region)

name.en: A formed goal revised, and the operations it goes on through

mechanism.en: Periphery (`propext`, `Quot.sound`, `Classical.choice`), the two-practice construction supplied: two practices, their feedback and calibration laws, responsiveness, authority, initial work and reserve, and the scheduled sequence. A cycle needs 2 ≤ w and uses two units, of the reserve where the selector feeds the practice back and 2 ≤ q, else of the work; a practice runs n cycles from work w and reserve q exactly where n = 0, or 2 ≤ w and the work covers the cycles the reserve does not (natural subtraction and division). Acquisition, revision and reform complete for a condition exactly under access loss with kept transition maintenance, and afterwards n operations run exactly where n ≤ 5 (n ≤ 2 without reform), the earlier loss kept. Under the practical commitments the construction's comparison, which ranks one practice above another where it protects strictly more of the protected claims (access, maintenance) or the same with strictly more gains, ranks learning above attendance exactly under that condition. In witnesses a false reference leaves the goal in place despite a real loss, grounds gone stale leave a new loss unaddressed, and without response the goal is not revised though the grounds are the same. Not open discovery of ends.

to.en: witness: under a real access loss, an acquired attendance goal assessed with its reference set false (reference := some true) and then revised keeps the attendance goal

edge.en: A false reference leaves the attendance goal in place despite a real loss.

to.en: witness: under a real access loss, revision without response leaves the goal at attendance while revision with response moves it to learning, the grounds being the same

edge.en: Without response the goal is not revised though the grounds are the same.

to.en: witness: with access loss and transition loss together (crossed losses), revision leaves the goal at attendance and acquisition, revision and reform do not complete (completed = none)

edge.en: Crossed losses block revision.

to.en: witness: reform from a revised state whose work is one unit fails (none): a cycle needs two units of work

edge.en: Reform with work 1 fails.

condition.en: A practice runs n cycles from work w and reserve q exactly where n = 0, or 2 ≤ w and twice the cycles the reserve does not support is at most w.

from.en: n = 0, or 2 ≤ w and twice the cycles the reserve does not support is at most w: the practice runs n cycles

to.en: otherwise: the n cycles do not all run (cycles … returns none)

condition.en: Acquisition, revision and reform complete for a condition exactly under access loss with kept transition maintenance.

from.en: access loss with transition maintenance kept: acquisition, revision and reform complete

to.en: no access loss, or transition maintenance lost: completion fails (completed c = none)

condition.en: Under access loss with kept transition maintenance, after acquisition, revision and reform n operations run exactly where n ≤ 5; without reform, exactly where n ≤ 2.

from.en: after acquisition, revision and reform, n ≤ 5: the n operations run, and every such run ends with the goal learning, one loss kept and the archive at 2 + n; without reform, the n operations run exactly where n ≤ 2

to.en: n > 5 after reform (n > 2 without reform): the n operations do not all run

open.en: The comparison's definitions belong to the construction: the warrant it gives is the construction's under the practical commitments, not a consequence of the counting law.
Universal motivation and the biological realization of goal revision do not follow.

name.en: What a line must hold, and what a regularity takes in

mechanism.en: For every carrier, relation and class. Where a region, given by a decided predicate, is left under a class only into a set, a line under that class from inside the region to outside holds a member of that set alike to its start, and reaches it; where the class holds none of them alike to the start, nothing outside is reached. A class holds a member's effects where everything the member conditions is alike to it. With no regularity assumed, everything downstream of a member lies on its line under a class exactly where everything downstream of it is alike to it, that is, where the class holds the effects of the member and of each stage of its line. Under constancy up to the net's end at the member's class (whatever an alike occurrence conditions, this one conditions something alike to it, unless this one conditions nothing), where the member conditions something and the class holds its effects, everything downstream of anything alike to it is alike to it and on a line under the class from there. A line that ends while its last stage still conditions something fails both that condition and the reach. Neither premise can be dropped from these laws (Unclosed, Inconstant, witnesses), and the reach does not need the condition (OtherLeaves, a witness).

declarations: Becoming.«亡而网续则本类不至终有常»
Becoming.«后皆续当且仅当后皆同类»
Becoming.«后皆续当且仅当自与线皆闭»

to.en: for a class E, everything downstream of m lies on its line under E exactly where everything downstream of m is alike to it; with no regularity assumed

exits.law: Becoming.«后皆续当且仅当后皆同类»

edge.en: Everything downstream of a member lies on its line under a class exactly where everything downstream of it is alike to it, with no regularity assumed.

to.en: not everything downstream of m lies on its line under E: the line from m ends at y while y still conditions something

edge.en: Where a line from the member ends while its last stage still conditions something, not everything downstream of the member lies on its line.

to.en: witness (Unclosed): under a constant class holding the member with a condition its line runs through, the member's effects leave the class, and what the condition feeds is not alike to the member and is not reached on its line

edge.en: Where a member's line runs through a condition but the member's effects leave its class, a constant class holding the member with the condition does not reach what the condition feeds.

to.en: witness (Inconstant): a class holding the member's effects that is not constant even up to the net's end has something downstream of the member not alike to it

edge.en: Where the class is not constant even up to the net's end, a class holding a member's effects need not have what follows them alike to it.

open.en: That a self's own line runs under a class constant up to the net's end, or that its class holds its effects (the path's P2 and P4: the de se question as two questions).
That a class holding only a member's intended effects can, or cannot, be constant up to the net's end.
That one's line runs through the conditions one affects (P3) for actual selves.
Any duty or blame: holding one's effects is read as whose losses count, not what one answers for.
That P2 should be read at one's own class, or with the split: that is argued as a reading, not proved.
That the class of an actual agent's line holds the effects of each stage of its line, with P2 or without it (a correspondence).

premises.law: Becoming.«亡而网续则本类不至终有常»
Becoming.«后皆续当且仅当后皆同类»
Becoming.«后皆续当且仅当自与线皆闭»

name.en: Growth by attachment, and what a cut returns

mechanism.en: Core law, for every relation: every link of a relation grown by attachment separates its ends when cut, and after one join, cutting a grown link changes no closure exactly where the join crosses it. On the World, in a world grown by attachment, the two formations taking part in the condition that attached one to the other lie in one system and without that condition lie apart: every grown condition is needed. (Periphery; `propext`, `Quot.sound`, `Classical.choice`; local growth, differentiation, the event sequence, a support-consuming cut, catalytic correspondence and a common eight-slot preparation supplied.) Two actually grown eight-member graphs, a chain and a branched tree, matched in composition and parent summary, constrain their successors after one edge is removed: under exact connectivity certificates, each edge's certified return averaged with an uncertified cut counting 0, the chain's mean is three times the branched tree's, the oldest cut reverses that ranking and no function of the parent summary predicts it. A retaining edge can prevent fragmentation: the cut then uses up material and leaves one component. The trees are a model, not a measured organism.

to.en: with the grown link (p, n) cut, its ends lie apart: p and n are not within one closure of the remaining links

edge.en: Every link of a relation grown by attachment separates its ends when cut.

to.en: witness: with the retaining edge (0, 7) aggregated onto the chain, cutting (3, 4) leaves one component of all eight, so the cut certificate fails and the cut returns nothing

edge.en: An actual aggregation adds the retaining edge (0,7) to the chain; after cutting (3,4) it stays one component of all eight, so the certificate fails and the cut returns nothing.

condition.en: After one join, cutting a grown link changes no closure exactly where the join crosses it.

from.en: the join crosses the cut link: without it p reaches a and b reaches n, or p reaches b and a reaches n; cutting the grown link changes no closure

to.en: the join does not cross the cut link: cutting the grown link changes some closure

open.en: Growth does not fix fragmentation: an additional retaining edge can prevent it.
The old preparation output did not rebuild its developmental graph and cannot by itself be iterated as a growth rate.
The laws do not say which links form, which are cut, or when, nor what the parts on either side do after a cut.
The validity of the inference and its biological correspondence are separate: the trees are a model, not a measured organism.

name.en: Renewal and consumption classify runs

mechanism.en: Every run of every process, read through observables of conditions (levels and activity at each configuration; requirements, needs and draws fixed), is a web to which the classes of renewing and consuming formation apply: a class of the whole run, relative to that run. A natural-number observable not rising across any step from T on does not fall at arbitrarily late steps. Three cases: where every admissible step lowers a natural-number reserve, the process has no run; along a run where every step that is not a renewal lowers a natural-number rank, no tail is free of renewal; along a run where from T on a condition's level never rises and falls across every step at which a formation is active, the formation is not active at arbitrarily late steps. The class belongs to the run (the renewable process, a witness): from one configuration, the focal formation active at every step, one run renews and another consumes the condition the sustaining formation depends on, and the sustaining formation ends. The three cases are known bounds, organized as cases of one principle.

to.en: it is not the case that the formation f is active at arbitrarily late steps of the run (¬ ∀ N, ∃ t, N ≤ t ∧ f active at t)

edge.en: From T on a condition's level never rises across a step and falls across every step at which a formation is active: the formation is not active at arbitrarily late steps.

to.en: the process has no run: where every admissible step lowers a natural-number reserve, no infinite execution exists

edge.en: Where every admissible step lowers a natural-number reserve of the configuration, the process has no run.

to.en: witness (Renewable): from one configuration, with the focal formation active at every step of both runs, drawing two units a step where the condition gains one consumes it (ConsumingIn) and the sustaining formation is inactive at every step from one on, while drawing one renews (RenewingIn)

edge.en: Drawing two units a step where a condition gains one, the focal formation consumes the condition, and the sustaining formation, depending on it at need one, is inactive at every step from one on; drawing one from the same configuration, it renews.

open.en: It proves none of self-significance, both neutralities, A, C, L or the practical commitments, and refutes no position rejecting them.
The principle is not shown to give the well-founded form of recurrent renewal, more general than a natural-number rank.
Neither the philosophical warrant for the whole-run relational reading nor that it is the right reading of 生生 is shown.
The reading is of the whole run, relative to that run, with dependence and drawing fixed and no component of further generation; no correspondence discipline for conditions is stated for it.
A formation's class depends on its identity across steps; a condition's class does not.
The renewable witness has no feedback: its loss beyond renewal lasts only while drawing exceeds renewal, so it shows no irreversible loss.

how.en: Amounts.rests with the amounts the whole numbers, the least loss ε := 1, the marked steps the strict falls of the rank and m := rank T + 1 (Amounts.whole_within); rests is listed under family G's least-loss-rest.
